direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; preserve fit without shrinking interactive targets below 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for the stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo tile above the inspector; retain only the header placement here and the opening-story placement.
Enlarge DOES NOT MATCH and the 120 versus 80 track ends so the mismatch reads at stage distance without leaning on colour.
Add a visible focus ring to evidence rows and link row hover to the matching SVG bar in both directions.
Keep Route health pre-flight, including nonce and identity status, in its own labelled group, fully separated from the Investigation source-evidence group below.
Enlarge the route select to 40px and show its focus ring against the raised panel.
Trim the offline explanation to one status sentence so Run Sample investigation remains the single primary.
Preserve the flow where selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; keep the exact phrase, character count and disabled Accept state adjacent.
Align 83h, 35h, 17.5h and all costs in tabular columns across the three option cards.
Give the selected card a pattern edge plus Selected path text, not colour alone.
Fix the overlapping MAT-ALLOY-B route label and 40 via CELL-MILL-1 text over JOB-1001; reroute the label into clear space.
State 0 BLOCKED prior and 3 PROPOSED replacements once in the board header; keep every proposal marked UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Refit the task list so the third proposal and Decline proposal are visible without relying on a thin internal scrollbar.
Before Apply second shock, preview CELL-MILL-2 with dashed silver plus PREVIEW text only; reserve red for the actual stopped state after application.
Enlarge the machine select to 40px and pair the invalidation warning with the DecisionBar status centre.
Remove the faint admin scenario line or raise its contrast to meet body-text legibility.
Keep stoppedRed strictly on CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED; keep all other machines and routes silver or neon.
Separate route-health pre-flight nonce and identity checks from the reinvestigation evidence task with distinct headings and controls, as in step 2.
Make CONSTRAINED on Split available capacity legible with an x marker and short reason beside the option chip.
Refit the inspector so the typed consent field and 0/27 status are fully visible at 768px without clipping the DecisionBar.
Show the constrained Split card with dashed pattern, x marker and Split requires at least two online compatible cells at full contrast.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in the DecisionBar centre and disabled Accept until the exact revised phrase matches.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visibly grouped beside the approved recovery plan while the 3 replacement proposals stay UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Fix route-label overlap at CELL-MILL-1 and JOB-1002 so 30 via CELL-MILL-1 never collides with the neon path.
Add pattern plus text to the blocked prior group so blocked is not carried by position alone.
Refit the retained-evidence column so Verify ledger, passphrase, Seal encrypted packet and Export independent checkpoint all fit or scroll with a clear internal-scroll cue.
Keep one primary only: Verify ledger in the DecisionBar until verification completes, then advance the primary to the next incomplete action.
Align 70, 35h and 48h metrics on one tabular baseline and label 48h as saved versus replenishment.
Add a final status summary in the DecisionBar centre using existing sealed state only: packet sealed, 18 events, revised plan accepted, CELL-MILL-2 offline retained.
Ensure Recovery story complete in the rail carries aria-current and a check marker plus text, not colour alone.
Remove the stray neon outline around the integrity line in the inspector and use a plain complete check with text.
